database.models.get_engine(database_url: str)[source]

Build a SQLAlchemy engine for the same PostgreSQL database used by load_data.py. The psycopg driver is selected explicitly, since plain “postgresql://” would otherwise resolve to SQLAlchemy’s default driver rather than the one this project installs.

Parameters:

database_url (str) – A “postgresql://user:password@host:port/dbname” connection string.

Returns:

The engine.

Return type:

sqlalchemy.engine.Engine

database.models.get_session(database_url: str) → Session[source]

Open a new SQLAlchemy Session bound to an engine for the same PostgreSQL database used by load_data.py.

Parameters:

database_url (str) – A “postgresql://user:password@host:port/dbname” connection string.

Returns:

The session. The caller is responsible for closing it.

Return type:

sqlalchemy.orm.Session
